Package arztis.econnector.rest.model

Class ConnectionData

java.lang.Object
arztis.econnector.rest.model.ConnectionData
public class ConnectionData
extends java.lang.Object
This class includes all data, which are important for the registration of the healthcare service provider (GDA). Moreover it has the HCP assertion as attribute, because every user have their own assertion. In this class a timer was set to renew the HCP assertion after 3h 55m. Furthermore the context assertions for different services such as virtual organizations and immunization record are stored for each user.
For users, which registered for the GINA, the created dialog is cached in this class.
Author:
